- **Scope:** av-cam CC 3D LUT and gamma, the Arrivederci/ARRI color work, debayer/PSF/detail stages, RAW develop, IMX284, CXD90045 DFE sensor front-end (DrvSGC0, SyncSeq, DfeTop, SLVS-EC, RdcW0), Open Gate and high-bit-depth paths, AIF DMA, the RCRAW probes, and the candidate mobile GPU 36-exposure ARW roll pipelines (SpektraFilm and fotufilm-engine).

The evidence records are authoritative; follow the links before acting on a claim.

## Entities

### <a id="img-cc-lut"></a>av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma

`img.cc-lut` | process

av-cam's CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) applied before 8-bit output.

Aliases: `CC:`, `EC_Gamma`, `5x9x9 YCbCr`, `CC+8`

Current knowledge:

- **C01** `OFFLINE` av-cam.bin applies a CC: 3D LUT (5x9x9 YCbCr), a 3x3 Q10 color matrix and EC_Gamma (96 x uint16) before the 8-bit stage. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md))
- **C02** `PHYSICAL` Arrivederci applies without a Color Mode round trip because CC+8 is refilled every frame; it uses a matrix fitted to the official ARRI Classic LUT, and an A/B recording test (C0029 on vs C0030 off) verified it live. ([E0555](../evidence/0555-arrivederci-menu-exit-recompute-and-cc8-refill.md), [E0556](../evidence/0556-arrivederci-classic-fitted-matrix.md), [E0610](../evidence/0610-live-a6400-arrivederci-v4-zebra-ab-test.md))
- **C11** `PHYSICAL` A live 4K S-Log3 read-only check captured the CC: RefAdr buffers. ([E0612](../evidence/0612-live-a6400-4k-slog3-cc-refadr-state.md))
- **C16** `INFERENCE` Combining a GPU ARW 2.3 16-byte block unpack + shared-memory RCD demosaic + fused 3x3 matrix kernel, uniform reciprocity log-exposure offsets (preserving 100% roll cache residency), 256 MB pooled Metal / single-VkCommandBuffer batched Vulkan 0.5 MP fused tiles, and selective Float16 exposure/halation/grain storage (keeping LogExposure, Curves, FilmDensity and FilmTiles SATs in Float32) bounds a 36-exposure 24 MP roll within ~198-342 MB dirty memory (~18-38 s projected flagship wall time), while lut_bridge.fit_cube_to_isp fits a 33^3 stock .cube onto BIONZ X's 5x9x9 RefAdr[0] LUT for EVF framing. ([E0505](../evidence/0505-av-cam-cc-3dlut-and-ec-gamma-pipeline.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

- **C04** `PHYSICAL` Live read-only checks of dcv_psf and spica state in MSC and 4K movie mode support a static proof of dynamic 4K dcv_psf reload and a systemic dcv_psf / PP_Detail contract. ([E0604](../evidence/0604-av-cam-dcv-psf-spica-ram-addresses-and-prototypes.md), [E0605](../evidence/0605-live-a6400-msc-dcv-psf-spica-state-check.md), [E0606](../evidence/0606-offline-step-response-and-systemic-dcv-contract.md), [E0608](../evidence/0608-live-a6400-4k-movie-dcv-and-mount-state.md), [E0609](../evidence/0609-av-cam-4k-dcv-dynamic-reload-proof.md))

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Upstream SpektraFilm (3bb2c2d) executes no runtime ODE or PDE solvers, reducing photochemical development to 81-band (380-780 nm) spectral contractions, 1D/2D/3D LUTs, 3-sublayer Poisson-Binomial grain draws and Gaussian/exponential convolutions; Sony ARW 2.3 cRAW (Compression=32767) stores independent 128-bit (16-byte) even/odd row blocks, and CinemaHUD Android already supports 2..65 3D .cube live-view LUT preview in shaders/monitor.frag. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0689](../evidence/0689-fotufilm-engine-mobile-gpu-film-roll-architecture.md))

### <a id="img-recording-paths"></a>Open Gate, high-bit-depth and RAW video paths

`img.recording-paths` | process | inventory `firmware.elf:nflasha15_unpacked/scenario/CAMERA_SCN_EXTERNAL_RAW_RECORD.so`

Feasibility of 3:2 Open Gate, 4K/6K low-fps, 10-bit and RAW/YCC paths, the AIF DMA channel map, the unwired 0x40BD 3G-SDI FS-RAW stub, DDR-B SHS RAW buffering, QFHD HDMI UYVY transport, and the 8-bit ZIMA_AVC ceiling.

Aliases: `Open Gate 3:2`, `ZIMA_AVC`, `AIF`, `SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT`, `CAMERA_SCN_EXTERNAL_RAW_RECORD.so`, `0x40BD`, `SuperSlowManagerMainLsi`

Current knowledge:

- **C06** `OFFLINE` Open Gate 3:2 recording, 4K/6K low-fps paths and 10-bit / 11-14-bit RAW/YCC video paths were mapped statically and in Unicorn; sabin ZIMA_AVC encoders cap at 8-bit 4:2:0. ([E0578](../evidence/0578-a6400-open-gate-3-2-recording-feasibility.md), [E0620](../evidence/0620-a6400-open-gate-4k-and-6k-paths.md), [E0621](../evidence/0621-a6400-10bit-and-raw-video-paths.md), [E0627](../evidence/0627-a6400-zima-avc-8bit-ceiling.md))
- **C07** `OFFLINE` The AIF DMA channel table and the SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT gate were mapped; AIF0/1 W1/W2 semantics and the RCRAW DDR path decoded; RCRAW line/block calculation verified in Unicorn. ([E0622](../evidence/0622-a6400-aif-dma-channel-map-and-raw-external-gate.md), [E0623](../evidence/0623-a6400-aif-w1-w2-rcraw-registers.md), [E0624](../evidence/0624-a6400-rcraw-calc-unicorn.md))
- **C17** `OFFLINE` In ILCE-6100 av-cam.bin (58b2118d...), RCRAW_EN (0x643EE0F4) and RDRAW_EN (0x643EE4B0) only drive FOPD (0x63777380) and AIF W0/W1 (0x63DC4D94/0x63DC4DA0); AIF0 W2 (0xF3002480 via 0x63DC4DA6 -> 0x63777064) is separately gated by 0x643EDF60 (S_SetFOPD 0x63B483C0 <- 0x6393BDA8 <- SyncGetPrcFlow 0x63B2E80C and DFS 0x6455F1B0 in {2, 3}), and CalcSdevOutSize (0x63DBEFBA) hard-caps SyncGetPrcFlow/Astra output at 640x360, 640x426, or 640x480. ([E9105](../evidence/9105-a6100-rcraw-aif-w2-and-fopd-gates.md))
- **C18** `OFFLINE` All 19 IMX284 modes in ILCE-6400 av-cam.bin (90d515cf...) output 11/12/14-bit Bayer RAW (never 8-bit), while CAMERA_SCN_EXTERNAL_RAW_RECORD.so (842fa541...) sends UIPC 0x40BD (0x00DC0000 -> 0x00030001) paired with OBJDISPLAY::SequenceSetSdiLineoutInternalOn (3G-SDI FS-RAW) to av-cam.bin idx 0xA6 (0x63BE0648, gated by *0x64408588 == 0x00BF0274 in 0x63BE06E0), where [0x64407C40+0x878..0x880] has no pipeline readers and completion field [r4+0x6D4] (0x63BDC8D8) is only zero-initialized at 0x63D73B68; DmmConfig.bin (3e68b4f4...) maps 1,024 MiB DDR-B (0x80000000..0xC0000000, tag 0x0012) and 384 MiB DDR-A (0x24000000..0x3C000000, tag 0x0010) with SuperSlowManagerMainLsi unit 0x0332 set to size 0, and hdmi.ko (cc70cc59...) fixes 8-bit TMDS (addr_0803_1_0 = 0) with 3840x2160p24/25/30 YCbCr 4:2:2 cells and 1..254 range clipping (hdmi_core_set_csc_range_clip). ([E0739](../evidence/0739-a6400-10bit-raw-video-feasibility-and-external-raw-stub.md))
- **C19** `INFERENCE` Within ILCE-6400 hardware limits (8-bit ZIMA_AVC ceiling, <= 640x480 FOPD/AIF0 W2 cap, unwired 0x40BD SDI stub, and 104 MB/s UHS-I SDR104 bus), >=10-bit Bayer RAW video is bounded to three architectures: (1) continuous 2K (1996x1122 or 1996x1332 @ 24-29.97p) via hardware 0xF3030000 ARW 2.3 cRAW2 (1.0 B/px, 11-bit endpoints, 53.7-79.7 MB/s) or 10-bit packing (67.1 MB/s @ 24p) to UHS-I V60/V90 SD, (2) 1.0 GiB DDR-B RAM-ring-buffered cRAW2 bursts (~5.4-6.9 s @ 3840x2160p24, ~2.2-3.3 s @ 4896x2760p30 or 6000x3376p24) spooled to SD post-capture, and (3) continuous 3840x2160p24/25/30 Clean HDMI UYVY tunneling packing 7 bits/byte in 0x40..0xBF (14.51 MB/frame, surviving 1..254 range clipping) for uncompressed 4K 10/12/14-bit Bayer or 4896x2760p30 cRAW2. ([E0620](../evidence/0620-a6400-open-gate-4k-and-6k-paths.md), [E0715](../evidence/0715-qemu-f01-playback-capture-uhs-mmio-and-kexec-prereqs.md), [E0739](../evidence/0739-a6400-10bit-raw-video-feasibility-and-external-raw-stub.md))
- **C20** `OFFLINE` Unlocking ExlHelper output_aspect = 0 (3:2) on stock unbinned IMX284 Mode 16/17 (6000x3376 @ 24p/25p, FE <= 3445 avoiding E0728 Lost CAMOUT_V) and Mode 15 (4896x2760 @ 30p) invokes Sony's 0x6376E17C / 0x63CE2232 horizontal crop to extract 5064x3376 (17.09 MP 5.1K) and 4140x2760 (11.43 MP 4.1K) supersampled into 3240x2160 (validated by 0x63D67224 height == 2160 and MprLibCore::EncOpen .text +0x87025A/+0x870266 / +0x870696/+0x8706A2), while diffing all 13 IMX284 reglist columns isolates reg 0x0001 = 0x41 (16:9 window in cols 6,7,9,10,11) vs 0x40 (full-gate 3:2 continuous in cols 3,4,12, including Mode 10 0x44 1996x1332 unity capacitive averaging). ([E0728](../evidence/0728-a6400-open-gate-f3851-mmio-live.md), [E0741](../evidence/0741-open-gate-32-mode10-smod-v2.md))
- **C21** `PHYSICAL` OpenGateA1 MP4-header hooks now target the captured camera libmpr.so (bb31351c...): tkhd +0x8612AC and stsd +0x8615F4 (unique 12-byte stock patterns, E0756 shift -0xF480; reference VAs 0x079A52AC / 0x079A55F4). The copied prologues are position-independent except tkhd's cbnz, whose taken path (return 4) the hook reproduces; build opengate-a1-build-2 (16f7c974...) passes the Unicorn test. Live (E0757): the stock bytes are at both addresses in im.elf and the mod applies (337 sites, 16 words, both hooks) and restores cleanly, but recording never called the hooked functions and the output stayed 16:9 because the id-0 output descriptors remain 3840x2160. ([E0756](../evidence/0756-opengate-a1-libmpr-hook-sites-and-guarded-test-kit.md), [E0757](../evidence/0757-opengate-a1-captured-libmpr-hooks-and-fast-loop-kit.md))
- **C22** `PHYSICAL` Codec10 (mods/codec10, tools/codec10) implements a >8-bit Bayer/gray codec (14->10/12-bit minifloat curve, pack/Rice/BFL modes, crash-safe .c10 container) and verifies Cortex-A5 (no NEON, AT_HWCAP 0x1E0D7, ~520 MHz) performance on live ILCE-6400: 3-thread 1080p pack-mf runs in 25.2 ms wall (62.22 MB/s @ 24p, verify PASS), while fused BFL runs in 58.0 ms wall (38.29 MB/s, 1.625x smaller, verify PASS); 13/13 WSL tests match the Python reference bit-exactly, and the >8-bit frame tap remains open. ([E0758](../evidence/0758-codec10-high-bit-depth-cortex-a5-codec.md))

### <a id="img-rcraw"></a>RCRAW block (0xF3031xxx) and its probes

`img.rcraw` | process

RCRAW line/block calculation, quantization selector, global enable gate and AIF0/1 W1/W2 registers, probed in Unicorn, QEMU and on the camera.

Aliases: `RCRAW_EN`, `0xF30317C8`, `RCRAW_SET 0x63B2D560`

Current knowledge:

- **C07** `OFFLINE` The AIF DMA channel table and the SET_RAW_EXTERNAL_OUTPUT gate were mapped; AIF0/1 W1/W2 semantics and the RCRAW DDR path decoded; RCRAW line/block calculation verified in Unicorn. ([E0622](../evidence/0622-a6400-aif-dma-channel-map-and-raw-external-gate.md), [E0623](../evidence/0623-a6400-aif-w1-w2-rcraw-registers.md), [E0624](../evidence/0624-a6400-rcraw-calc-unicorn.md))

([E0625](../evidence/0625-rcraw-w2-probe-smod-v2-unicorn.md), [E0626](../evidence/0626-rcraw-w2-probe-qemu-execution.md), [E0628](../evidence/0628-a6400-rcraw-callers-and-0xf30317c8.md), [E0629](../evidence/0629-a6400-rcraw-quant-selector-and-0xf3031xxx.md), [E0630](../evidence/0630-rcraw-enable-test-smod-v2.md), [E0631](../evidence/0631-rcraw-enable-test-qemu-reload-and-aif-baseline.md))

([E0632](../evidence/0632-a6400-hardware-rcraw-aif-msc-baseline.md), [E0633](../evidence/0633-a6400-hardware-rcraw-enable-test-live-run.md), [E0634](../evidence/0634-a6400-hardware-rcraw-post-recording-check.md))
- **C10** `OFFLINE` RCRAW_SET (0x63B2D560) and 0x63767ACC map to the 160..640 FOPD sub-path, with hardware G1/G2 readback. ([E0635](../evidence/0635-a6400-rcraw-fopd-vs-full-pipeline.md))
- **C17** `OFFLINE` In ILCE-6100 av-cam.bin (58b2118d...), RCRAW_EN (0x643EE0F4) and RDRAW_EN (0x643EE4B0) only drive FOPD (0x63777380) and AIF W0/W1 (0x63DC4D94/0x63DC4DA0); AIF0 W2 (0xF3002480 via 0x63DC4DA6 -> 0x63777064) is separately gated by 0x643EDF60 (S_SetFOPD 0x63B483C0 <- 0x6393BDA8 <- SyncGetPrcFlow 0x63B2E80C and DFS 0x6455F1B0 in {2, 3}), and CalcSdevOutSize (0x63DBEFBA) hard-caps SyncGetPrcFlow/Astra output at 640x360, 640x426, or 640x480. ([E9105](../evidence/9105-a6100-rcraw-aif-w2-and-fopd-gates.md))

### <a id="app-android-spektrafilm"></a>CinemaHUD Android SpektraFilm engine (candidate)

`app.android-spektrafilm` | host

Two-tier Android film simulation architecture: live-view 3D .cube preview in apps/android/cinemahud/shaders/monitor.frag plus a candidate 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute engine for developing 36-exposure 24 MP ARW 2.3 rolls via SpektraFilm's spectral-spatial model.

Aliases: `SpektraFilm`, `CinemaHUD Android`, `ARW2 GPU`, `film roll`

Current knowledge:

- **C12** `OFFLINE` Upstream SpektraFilm (3bb2c2d) executes no runtime ODE or PDE solvers, reducing photochemical development to 81-band (380-780 nm) spectral contractions, 1D/2D/3D LUTs, 3-sublayer Poisson-Binomial grain draws and Gaussian/exponential convolutions; Sony ARW 2.3 cRAW (Compression=32767) stores independent 128-bit (16-byte) even/odd row blocks, and CinemaHUD Android already supports 2..65 3D .cube live-view LUT preview in shaders/monitor.frag. ([E0601](../evidence/0601-arw-superpixel-2x2-prototype.md), [E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))
- **C13** `INFERENCE` Replacing desktop spektrafilm-rs's 8-10 full-frame f32 buffers and 162 per-pixel pow loops with a 3-pass NDK Vulkan compute pipeline (GPU uvec4 ARW2 unpack + 64x32 RCD demosaic, RGBA16F mip-pyramid scatter/halation/DIR convolutions, and a once-per-roll 65^3 + 49^3 3D LUT pair) fits a 36-exposure 24 MP roll inside ~323 MB full-frame (~114 MB 4-strip) peak memory on Adreno, Mali and Xclipse GPUs. ([E0688](../evidence/0688-android-gpu-spektrafilm-film-roll-architecture.md))

Related: [av-cam CC 3D LUT, color matrix and EC gamma](#img-cc-lut), [Debayer, dcv_psf / spica and detail stages](#img-detail-psf)

### <a id="img-dfe-sgc0-syncseq"></a>CXD90045 DFE sensor front-end: DrvSGC0, SyncSeq, DfeTop, SLVS-EC and RdcW0

`img.dfe-sgc0-syncseq` | device

72 MHz CXD90045/CXD90057 DFE sensor timing generator (DrvSGC0 at 0xFC0A1100..0xFC0A1BE0), SYSV-qualified frame sequencer (SyncSeq at 0xFC080000..0xFC080114), DfeTop W1S/W1C core/IRQ router (0xFC0A0000..0xFC0A0208, GIC IRQs 135/136), 64 KiB DFE ARM mailbox (0xFC0300F4..FC), SLVS-EC link lock (0xFC0F00B0), and RdcW0 Bayer RAW DMA writers (0xFC0E1100 and 0xFC0A9200).

Aliases: `DrvSGC0`, `SyncSeq`, `DfeTop`, `RdcW0`, `SLVS-EC`, `0xFC0A1100`, `0xFC080000`, `0xFC0E1100`, `0xFC0F00B0`, `dfe_dat.bin`

Current knowledge:

- **C23** `OFFLINE` Across ILCE-6400 2.00 (av-cam.bin 90d515cf...), ILCE-6400A 1.01 (3029a174...), and ZV-E10 2.02/2.03 (bc6cba98..., qn06142/zv-e10-re@9b5debdd5f), dfe_dat.bin (703f457a..., 65,536 B) and dfe_app.bin (8f9a8d3f..., 1,956 B) are bit-identical and DrvSgc (0xFC0A1100..0xFC0A1BE0: +0x1108[0] internal trig_mode=0 start, +0x1130[16] trig_mode=1 SYSV/SyncSeq VD0 vs trig_mode=2 EXT_SYNC mux, +0x113C[0] Vd0Mask, +0x1194[16]/+0x1198[16] HD0/VD0 pad commits, +0x119C[16] secondary sync, +0x11A8/+0x11AC 17/97 fractional NLR -> 1,201,200 ticks = 0x00125430 @ 72 MHz, +0x1B80..1BE0 NLR LUT), SyncSeq (0xFC080000..0xFC080114: +0x030 live interval, +0x038 = 0x00125430, +0x0F4 = 0x00012AC8 -> P2S Ch 1 run-mode-0 burst #7), DfeTop W1S/W1C (0xFC0A0000/004, GIC IRQs 135/136 via 0xFC01FF00 VIC), SLVS-EC (0xFC0F00B0), and RdcW0 (0xFC0E1100 and 0xFC0A9200) replay identically in bounded Unicorn Thumb-2 execution (338 insns DrvSgc Mode-1, 583 insns SyncSeq_Setup). ([E0757](../evidence/0757-qemu-dfe-sgc0-syncseq-slvsec-rdcw0-pipeline.md))
- **C24** `INFERENCE` Cold bare-metal IMX284 bring-up stalls with DrvSGC0 0xFC0A1110 = 0x00000001 (HVcnt = 0x3FFF3FFF, Fcnt = 0x7C), SyncSeq 0xFC080030 = 0x00EE466C, P2S Ch 1 burst #7 (0x00B3 = 0x90) pending, and SLVS-EC 0xFC0F00B0 = 0 when upstream master SYSV (0xF3402000 + SUGI_CLK 0xF3400000 + CLKGEN 0xF280xxxx) is left unstarted while DrvSgc0Start uses trig_mode = 1 (0xFC0A1108[0] = 0, 0xFC0A1130[16] = 0) or if DfeTop BIT(8)/BIT(24) + 0xFC0A0108[0] = 1 / Leo 0xFC021024 BIT(6) == 0 are cleared. ([E0757](../evidence/0757-qemu-dfe-sgc0-syncseq-slvsec-rdcw0-pipeline.md))
